### 🟡 Changes recommended Interleaved indexless tool-call deltas with repeated IDs create duplicate buffers, leaving arguments incomplete and recorded tool calls missing names.
1 open issue - [Handle interleaved repeated IDs when buffering parallel calls](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-python-genai/pull/999#discussion_r4400442700) · New
What changed in this PR This PR updates Portkey’s streamed tool-call accumulation to separate calls that omit an index, preventing distinct calls from being merged in recorded spans. **Changes:** - Adds ID-based slot selection for indexless deltas while preserving explicit-index handling. - Adds unit tests for separate calls, consecutive repeated IDs, and indexed continuations. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-portkey/​tests/​test_choice_buffer.py` | Adds focused tool-call accumulation tests. | | `instrumentation/​opentelemetry-instrumentation-genai-portkey/​src/​opentelemetry/​instrumentation/​genai/​portkey/​wrappers.py` | Adds fallback slot selection for indexless tool-call deltas. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: Comparing the ID only with the final buffer splits an existing call whenever indexless parallel calls interleave. For example, deltas with IDs `call_1`, `call_2`, `call_1`, `call_2` create four buffers rather than two, leaving the original arguments incomplete and recording duplicate tool calls with missing names. Look up the ID across existing buffers before allocating a new slot, and add an interleaved repeated-ID regression case.
